controller.name: deploy_expert
controller.plan: so101Sim https://github.com/pulipakaa24/so101Sim rl/native/scripted_expert.py at d4c2990: its waypoints, damped-least-squares IK and phases
controller.command: absolute joint goals at 30 Hz, held between ticks (LeRobot SOFollower.send_action); the servo layer (command delay + firmware profile) turns them into each physics step's target
controller.perception: cube pose from the simulator state at each tick (not a camera)
controller.gravity_compensation: none (LeRobot has none for the SO arms)

servo.label: STS3215 7.4 V as Rhoban BAM's m6 identification (motor, firmware gain, load-dependent Stribeck gearbox friction) under LeRobot's registers, servo + host latency

adapter.physics: MuJoCo Warp BatchSim (metalsim.physics.batch), one 5 ms physics step per BatchSim step, 4 per 20 ms frame; before each, at the expert's 30 Hz ticks, a CPU MjData copy of each world's qpos / qvel with mj_forward for the expert; every physics step the servo layer's target into ctrl; box mass and friction per world (no set_const, as so101Sim)
adapter.done: 300 control steps (6 s) or box beyond 0.45 m (terminated); success does not end it

first_episode.ranking: success and still lifted at the end, then lowest RMS arm joint acceleration, then seed
